narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -6.49 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 1587.13-1589.00 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 1605.88; the first objective pays 1.54R at 1579.16.

plan.triggerRule: footprint div fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 1605.88 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 A/A+ demoted: no positive-delta absorption or CVD divergence at the pullback zone

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 26/100 — trend broken, liq magnets below, whales offering

factors.name: Liquidation Gravity
factors.detail: long liq $41 -2.9% below · short liq $19 +3.6% above
